newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel will free jailed Hamas leader if he's ill.
newsitem.headline: Israel will free jailed Hamas leader if he's ill.

text.p: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said Israel would free the spiritual leader of the Moslem militant group Hamas if it turned out the wheelchair-bound Palestinian cleric was ill.

"Certainly if he is ill there is no point in his sitting in jail," Netanyahu said of Sheikh Ahmed Yassin, 60, jailed for life in 1989, during an interview with the newspaper Haaretz published on Wednesday.

"It must be checked whether he is ill. One day there is one assessment and another day, another assessment...If he is healthy there is a point in his staying in jail and serving his sentence," Netanyahu said.

Palestinian President Yasser Arafat said this month that Israel would soon release the sheikh. Israel's public security minister said after visiting Yassin in December that there was room to discuss freeing him.

Yassin has been paralysed since an accident as a young man. Hamas has led violent opposition to interim Israel-PLO peace deals struck since 1993, carrying out four suicide bombings last year that killed 59 people in Israel.
